description: Language-neutral test vectors for every Versimo port. Generated from Versimo for TypeScript by spec/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand.

notes.transitions: Each case gives the input record, an op, its args, an optional by, and a fixed now. expected is the output record, or error is the error code.
notes.resolve: userId null means no user id. An empty string also means no user.
notes.validation: errors lists the field named at the start of each error message, in order.

resolve.name: unhealthy with no last stays on current

transitions.name: draftNext replaces next and resets rollout

validation.name: valid with no last and no next
updatedAt day 30 of February is accepted
ordering is skipped when fields are invalid
